sub_answers.text: He was named to the All-ACC First Team as a sophomore.[d30156859s2p0] He won ACC Defensive Player of the Year and ACC Player of the Year in his junior season.[d30156859s2p0] As a senior he won numerous national player of the year awards, including unanimous selections for the Oscar Robertson Trophy and the Naismith Award, and was voted ACC Player of the Year again.[d30156859s2p0]

sub_answers.text: He excelled as an interior rebounder and defensive presence, earning ACC Defensive Player of the Year honors and repeatedly leading Wake Forest in rebounds in key games [d30156859s2p0]. He produced strong low-post scoring and physical interior play, exemplified by 12 points and 22 rebounds in the Sweet 16 and 14 points, 16 rebounds and six assists in the Elite Eight [d30156859s2p0]. He acted as the team’s on-court leader, earning multiple ACC Player of the Year awards and national player of the year honors for his all-around impact [d30156859s2p0].

sub_answers.text: He primarily operated as a pick-and-roll ball-handler and was comfortable running a half-court offense and creating for others with elite on-ball vision and passing from the dribble [d56421329s9p0]. He relied on shooting off the dribble, including step-back jumpers and an advanced floater and was an accurate free-throw shooter with good touch around the rim, though his catch-and-shoot three-point shooting remained a work in progress [d56421329s9p0]. Scouts noted his above-average size for a point guard at 1.96 m (6 ft 5 in) and praised his shot form and ability to complete passes off a live dribble with his left hand, while also describing him as not an extraordinary athlete and prone to turnovers [d56421329s9p0]. Defensively he could guard shooting guards and smaller small forwards and was more effective as an off-ball and pick-and-roll defender than as a lateral perimeter defender due to limited lateral quickness [d56421329s9p0]
